name: Four Seasons Resort and Residences Puerto Rico
positioning: Beachfront resort on Puerto Rico's northeastern coast, set within a 483-acre property in the Bahía Beach community
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with nature trails, kayaking and golf on site
Families, since Kids For All Seasons is a complimentary supervised program

facts.text: The resort is on Puerto Rico's northeastern coast within the exclusive Bahía Beach community.
The resort stretches along two miles (3.2 kilometres) of golden beach.
Perla is an elevated supper club serving premium seafood and cuts.
Ocean Terrace is an oceanfront Mediterranean restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Bahia Beach Golf Club has 18 holes and was designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr.

highlights.text: Over 65% of the property's 483 acres are considered sanctuary areas.
The resort is designated as a Certified Silver Audubon International Signature Sanctuary.
Kids For All Seasons is a complimentary, fully supervised program for children.
The resort offers a fully guided night kayak trip to the bioluminescent lagoon Laguna Grande.
The Governor Oceanfront Suite includes a private oceanfront beach cabana.

considerations.text: Spa facilities are open from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm.
Old San Juan is about 27 miles (43 kilometres) from the resort.
The resort is in Río Grande, just 30 minutes from San Juan.
WhataHotel notes hurricane season considerations during summer and fall.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
